title: Roadmap dependency mapping station and on-call handbook for cross-team releases
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Objective: Build a lightweight 'Mapping Station' to visualize roadmap dependencies across Eng/Design/Security/Infra and ship an accompanying on-call handbook template that standardizes triage and cutover steps for cross-team releases.

Scope: Interactive dependency map in Console (read-only for first iteration) + downloadable on-call handbook templated per initiative. The map should: show owners, committed windows, blackout ranges, linked tickets, and a risk score. The handbook should include immediate escalation steps, pre-cutover checks, rollback criteria, and a communication cadence.

Deliverables: 1) Map prototype (read-only web component + JSON export spec). 2) Handbook template (Confluence + PDF). 3) Ingestion plan for owners & windows (CSV import / GitHub PR sync). 4) Quick-run playbook for on-call to use during release day and 72h post-cutover.

Acceptance criteria: - Map renders dependencies for at least three active initiatives in next-quarter roadmap. - Handbook contains explicit actions for Eng/Design/Security/Infra and passes tabletop drill with two partner teams. - Import path documented and two-way links to Linear tickets created. - Release notes and short training material published for SRE on-call rotation.
comments: 2025-02-12 — Kickoff: PM + Eng + Design + Security sync. Agreed MVP is read-only map + handbook template. Action: ENG to prototype data schema; DES to produce component spec. Attendees: Ayesha Patel, Jordan Kim, Priya Ramesh (Eng), Omar Lopez (Design), Mei Chen (Security).

2025-02-20 — Decision: MVP will not include live Slack/PagerDuty ingestion due to scope; instead we will support manual CSV/GitHub sync and a webhook spec for future automation. Rationale: reduce upfront security review and accelerate ship to end of cycle.

2025-02-25 — Security notes from Mei: ingest via signed webhook and support token-scoped read-only API keys. Security asks: include threat model doc and KMS plan before enabling any automated ingest for private deployments. Added to follow-ups.

2025-02-27 — Design update: component spec added (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RDMP/Mapping+Station+Component+Spec. Includes keyboard-first interactions and ARIA labels for accessibility. DES noted a trade-off: compact mode hides long descriptions; added hover card requirement to surface details.

2025-02-28 — Engineering update: prototype map renders sample CSV; JSON export format v0.1 at https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap-mapping/blob/main/schema/export-v0.1.json. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap-mapping/pull/12. Need design sign-off on hover card content.

2025-03-01 — Tabletop drill scheduled with SRE and Infra for 2025-03-07. Goal: validate handbook escalation steps and owner contact fields. Action: Jordan to capture drill script and failure injection scenarios.

2025-03-02 — PM note: we will prioritize making handbook downloadable as PDF with checklist pages for on-call. Also adding a short 'pre-cutover checklist' to appear as a modal in Console when cutover window approaches. Follow-ups captured as sub-issues.
